1. (Currently Amended) A method for preventing or treating glaucoma in a subject with glaucoma or at risk of developing glaucoma, wherein (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered.

2. (Currently Amended) A method for preventing or treating ocular hypertension in a subject with ocular hypertension or at risk of developing ocular hypertension, wherein (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered.

3. (Original) Claim 1 (Previously Presented): A preventing or treating agent for glaucoma comprising (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof.

4. (Original) Claim 2 (Previously Presented): A preventing or treating agent for ocular hypertension comprising (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof.

5. (Original) Claim 3 (Previously Presented): A composition for eye drops comprising (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof and a pharmaceutically accepted carrier.

6. (Original) Claim 9 (Previously Presented): A method for treating glaucoma comprising administering (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof to a subject in need thereof.

7. (Original) Claim 10 (Previously Presented): A method for treating ocular hypertention comprising administering (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof to a subject in need thereof.

8. (Original) Claim 11 (New): A method for enhancing an intraocular pressure-reducing action of (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or its salt, wherein phosphoric acid or a salt thereof is combined with (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof.

9. (Cancelled) Claim 12 (New).
